title: Keep project selections when adding a customer
steps: Inspect the open search filter with Northwind Studio and Eastwood Design selected, and Brand planning, Website design, and Content review selected as projects.
Type Westbridge in the Customer picker and select Westbridge Services; inspect the customer and project selections after the picker reloads.

video_guide.summary: Add Westbridge Services and compare the three original project selections with the resulting filter chips.

chapters.note: The open filter shows Northwind Studio and Eastwood Design in Customer, with Brand planning, Website design, and Content review in Project.

chapters.label: Find and select Westbridge Services in the Customer picker.

chapters.note: Customer shows Northwind Studio, Eastwood Design, and Westbridge Services; the customer options dropdown is still open.
The closed customer picker shows all three customer chips; Project shows Content review, Brand planning, and Website design.
The open filter still shows all three customer chips and all three project chips.
